paper.title: MALinZero: Efficient Low-Dimensional Search for Mastering Complex Multi-Agent Planning

settings.name_in_paper: Contextual linear bandit over n-hot joint actions (low-dimensional joint-action reward)
unmapped: Action set is the set of n-hot vectors in R^{nd} (one local action per agent among d_act per agent), so ambient dimension is n_ag*d_act and ||a||_2 <= sqrt(n_ag)
settings.definition_quote: we consider a contextual linear bandit problem with a finite joint-action set \(\mathcal{A} \subset \mathbb{R}^{nd}\) ... each joint action $a\in \mathcal{A}$ is represented by an $n$-hot vector ... \(X_t=\langle\theta^*, A_t\rangle + \varepsilon_t \). Here \(\varepsilon_t\) is conditionally \(1-\)subgaussian ... \(\|\theta^*\|_2 \le S\)

algorithms.name: LinUCT (weighted LinUCB with strongly-convex mu-smooth loss f)

symbols.d_act: number of actions per agent (paper's d); ambient dimension is n_ag*d_act
symbols.mu_f: smoothness constant of the loss f (f'' <= mu)
symbols.beta_T: confidence radius sqrt(2 mu ln(det(V_T)^{1/2}/(lam^{nd/2} delta))) + sqrt(lam) S

tuning: f strongly convex and mu-smooth (eps <= f'' <= mu)
beta_t = sqrt(2 mu ln(det(V_t)^{1/2}/(det(lam I)^{1/2} delta))) + sqrt(lam) S

source.label: thm:f-linucb
source.quote: [Regret Bound of LinUCT] With probability \(1-\delta\), the regret of LinUCT satisfies \hat{R}_t \le \sqrt{8\mu t \beta_t \operatorname{ln}\left(\frac{\operatorname{det}(V_t)}{\operatorname{det}(\lambda I)}\right)} \le \sqrt{8\mu ndt\beta_t\operatorname{ln}\left(\frac{nd \lambda + \mu nt}{nd\lambda}\right)}.

results.notes: Regret is the realized regret sum_t (X_t^* - X_t), including noise differences, bounded with probability 1-delta. beta_t appears unsquared inside the sqrt as stated; proof appears to have inconsistencies. Recorded the second (explicit) form of the bound.

symbols.d_act: number of actions per agent (paper's d)
symbols.mu_f: smoothness constant of the loss f

source.quote: [The Order of Regret Bound for LinUCT] Under the above conditions, the cumulative regret bound of LinUCT with \(\delta=1/T\) satisfies \hat{R}_T = O\left(nd\cdot \sqrt{\mu T}\cdot\operatorname{ln}(T)\right).

results.notes: Realized regret with delta=1/T; probability type not restated in the corollary, interpreted as holding w.p. 1-1/T.

cited_results.setting_description: Stochastic linear bandit with n-hot actions in R^{nd}, Euclidean least squares
